rules.name: rrr-dcs-deals-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT TRIM(t.trade_id) AS trade_id, t.contract_number, t.transaction_date, t.deal_status, t.netting_status, t.original_lots, t.premium, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs t JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs s ON s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.contract_number, '_', 1) = 'DCS' AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :fromDate)

SELECT trim(t.trade_id) AS trade_id, t.contract_number, t.transaction_date, t.deal_status, t.netting_status, t.original_lots, t.premium, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) = 'DCS' AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :fromDate)

SELECT trim(t.trade_id) AS trade_id, t.contract_number, t.transaction_date, t.deal_status, t.netting_status, t.original_lots, t.premium, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) = 'DCS' AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :fromDate)
